headline.dek: After 32 years of carrying passengers, the MV Petal will carry 8,000 books to 6 villages instead.
headline.title: The little ferry who became a library

beats.text: For 32 years, the brave little ferry carried people back and forth across the Willow River.
Soon her decks will be filled with 8,000 books instead, and she will be a library that floats.
From May 3, she will visit 6 villages along the river, and stay in each one for two days.
Captain Rosa Delgado, who steered the ferry for 20 years, will stay at the wheel for her new adventure.

data.closing: the villages by the river are getting a library of their own again, for the first time since 2019.
data.opening: In the town of Port Willow, a little ferry called the Petal had worked very hard for a very long time.

scenes.question: Tell me the story like a picture book
scenes.why: A light, happy story with one clear hero (the boat), a simple sequence of events, and a happy next chapter: the picture-book telling carries every fact without a chart.
